column2: It is customary to take off your shoes before entering a Taiwanese home.
column3: 進入台灣人的家之前先脫鞋是慣例。
column5: custom 習俗 + ary：照習俗來的

column2: He earned a decent salary, enough to rent a clean room and eat well.
column3: 他領的薪水還算像樣，足夠租一間乾淨的房間並吃得好。
column5: decent 像「滴神」：滴一滴汗換來體面的生活

column2: A decisive goal in the last minute won the match for our school.
column3: 最後一分鐘的決定性進球讓我們學校贏得比賽。
column5: de 切斷 + cis 切 → 一刀切定勝負

column2: The delinquent teenager skipped school and broke several neighborhood rules.
column3: 那名行為不良的青少年蹺課，還違反了好幾項社區規定。
column5: delinquent 像「得了寬」：得了寬鬆卻愈放愈野

column2: Brush twice a day, and visit the dentist for a dental checkup every six months.
column3: 一天刷兩次牙，並且每六個月去牙醫那裡做牙齒檢查。
column5: dent 牙齒：dentist 牙醫、dental 牙齒的

column2: The mayor designate will take office next month after the election.
column3: 當選的市長將在下個月就職，目前尚未上任。
column5: designate 放在名詞後：已被指定、尚未上任

column2: Many believe the young pianist is destined for fame.
column3: 許多人相信這位年輕鋼琴家註定會成名。
column5: destiny 命運 + ed：命運已經寫好的

column2: The flood was disastrous for the farmers and ruined their rice fields.
column3: 這場洪水對農民來說是災難性的，毀掉了他們的稻田。
column5: disaster 災難 + ous：會帶來災難的

column2: Please be discreet and keep my birthday surprise a secret.
column3: 請謹慎一點，替我保守生日驚喜的祕密。
column5: discreet 低調謹慎；discrete 是分開的，別混淆

column2: Cheating on the exam was a disgraceful act for a student leader.
column3: 對學生領袖來說，考試作弊是可恥的行為。
column5: dis 失去 + grace 優雅 → 失了面子

column2: In a tight budget, extra decorations are dispensable, but food is not.
column3: 預算吃緊時，額外的裝飾可有可無，但食物不行。
column5: dispense 分發出去 + able：可以放掉的

column2: At the picnic we used disposable plates, so washing up was easy.
column3: 野餐時我們用拋棄式盤子，所以清洗很輕鬆。
column5: dispose 丟掉 + able：用完可以丟的

column2: Our school has a diverse group of students from many different countries.
column3: 我們學校有來自許多不同國家的多元學生。
column5: di 分開 + verse 轉 → 往各種方向轉，各不相同

column2: We watched a documentary about whales swimming across the Pacific Ocean.
column3: 我們看了一部關於鯨魚橫越太平洋的紀錄片。
column5: document 文件 + ary：記錄真實的

column2: It was a dreary Monday, with gray skies and rain all day.
column3: 那是個沉悶的星期一，整天都是灰濛濛的天空和雨。
column5: dreary 像「大力」：烏雲大力壓下來，一整天沉悶

column2: The car has a dual purpose: it carries people and cargo.
column3: 這輛車有雙重用途：既載人也載貨。
column5: dual 像 duo 二重奏：兩個一起

column2: Not all wild mushrooms are edible, so never eat one without asking an expert.
column3: 並非所有野生菇類都能吃，沒問過專家絕對不要吃。
column5: ed 吃 (eat) + ible 可以 → 可以吃

column2: The editorial in today's paper argues that cities should plant more trees.
column3: 今天報紙的社論主張城市應該多種樹。
column5: editor 編輯 + ial：編輯寫的評論

column2: Only the elite athletes of the country can enter this training camp.
column3: 全國只有頂尖運動員才能進入這個訓練營。
column5: elite 像「伊力特」：選出來最強的一群

column2: Dad gave an emphatic no when I asked to stay up all night.
column3: 我問能不能熬夜一整晚時，爸爸斬釘截鐵地說不行。
column5: emphasis 強調 + tic：強力表達的

column2: An epidemic flu spread through the city, and many schools closed for a week.
column3: 一場流行性感冒席捲全市，許多學校停課一週。
column5: epi 在上面 + dem 人民 → 蓋在人群上的

column2: One kilometer is equivalent to one thousand meters.
column3: 一公里等於一千公尺。
column5: equi 相等 + val 價值 → 價值一樣

column2: Taiwan is home to many ethnic groups, each with its own songs and festivals.
column3: 台灣有許多族群，每個族群都有自己的歌曲和節慶。
column5: ethnic 像「一熟你可」：同族人互相熟悉

column2: Excessive screen time can make your eyes tired and your sleep worse.
column3: 過度使用螢幕會讓眼睛疲勞，睡眠變差。
column5: ex 超出 + cess 走 → 走過頭了

column2: This exclusive club accepts only members who are invited by a current member.
column3: 這個高級俱樂部只收現任會員邀請的人。
column5: ex 外面 + clude 關 → 把別人關在外面

column2: The tea shop serves exquisite cakes decorated like tiny flowers.
column3: 這家茶店供應裝飾得像小花朵般的精緻蛋糕。
column5: exquisite 像「一個細絲」：細絲般精緻

column2: I joined the chess club as an extracurricular activity after school.
column3: 我放學後參加西洋棋社，當作課外活動。
column5: extra 額外 + curricular 課程的 → 課表以外
column7: ex - tra - cur - ric - u - lar

column2: We had a fabulous holiday on the island, with sunny beaches every day.
column3: 我們在島上度過了極棒的假期，每天都有晴朗的海灘。
column5: fable 寓言故事 + ous：像童話一樣不可思議

column2: Earth's oil supply is finite, so we must find clean energy.
column3: 地球的石油供應是有限的，所以我們必須找到乾淨能源。
column5: fin 結束 (final) + ite：有盡頭的

column2: The firefighters wore fireproof suits when they entered the burning house.
column3: 消防員進入著火的房子時穿著防火衣。
column5: fire 火 + proof 防得住 → 火燒不壞

column2: Water is a fluid, so it takes the shape of any glass.
column3: 水是流體，所以會變成任何杯子的形狀。
column5: fluid 像「福路」：福氣像水路一樣流動

column2: The champion team faced a formidable opponent in the final match.
column3: 冠軍隊在決賽中遇到了一位難以對付的對手。
column5: formidable 像「佛咪的包」：佛都怕的強敵

column2: The author's forthcoming book will be published in the spring.
column3: 這位作家即將出版的新書將在春天上市。
column5: forth 向前 + coming 來 → 往前來到

column2: The frail old man held the railing as he climbed the stairs.
column3: 那位虛弱的老先生爬樓梯時扶著欄杆。
column5: frail 像「福瑞兒」：福氣瑞氣都像易碎的玻璃

column2: The movie contained graphic scenes of a flood, so it was not for young kids.
column3: 這部電影有洪水的寫實畫面，所以不適合小孩。
column5: graph 圖 + ic：像圖畫一樣清楚生動

column2: The university gave the famous writer an honorary degree.
column3: 大學頒給那位著名作家榮譽學位。
column5: honor 榮譽 + ary：給你面子而不用修課

column2: The villagers were hospitable and offered us tea and fruit.
column3: 村民非常好客，請我們喝茶吃水果。
column5: hospital 醫院本是招待客人的地方；好客

column2: The charity sent humanitarian aid, such as food and blankets, to the earthquake area.
column3: 慈善機構把食物和毯子等人道援助送到地震災區。
column5: human 人 + itarian：重視人、幫助人
column7: hu - man - i - tar - i - an

column2: The crowd was hysterical with joy when the singer walked onto the stage.
column3: 歌手走上舞台時，群眾興奮到失控。
column5: hysterical 像「嗨死的可」：嗨到失控了

column2: His silence was an implicit yes; nobody needed to say the word aloud.
column3: 他的沉默是不言明的同意，沒有人需要把話說出口。
column5: im 在裡面 + plic 摺 → 意思摺在裡面沒說出來
